subject: Remove redundant dict_index calculations (#1205)
reason: This is a pure performance refactor with no behavioral change. In both lookupKey and keysCommand the change only removes redundant recomputations of a key's dict index (hash slot). getKVStoreIndexForKey is a deterministic function of the key, so computing it once and reusing it yields the same value the repeated calls produced. In keysCommand the iterator's current dict index (kvstoreIteratorGetCurrentDictIndex / pslot) provably equals keyHashSlot(key) for every yielded key, since a key is stored in the dict matching its slot and the expires kvstore is indexed identically, so the expiry filter
